target_customer: Pharma partners and eventually oncology patients; revenue would come from licensing or drug development milestones
problem: Cancer cells evolve resistance to single targeted drugs, and traditional drug development is too costly for proteins that drive cancer in few patients.
business_model: Drug discovery biotech: AI platform to design combination therapies, value from licensing or partnerships

founders.name: Adam Yaari
education: PhD and MS computer science, MIT
MSc computer science and mathematics, Weizmann Institute of Science
BSc computer science and neuroscience, Bar-Ilan University
founders.background_notes: YC launch post describes him as a former Navy SEALs commander with over 10 years of entrepreneurship.

founders.name: Maxwell Sherman
education: Applied math and biology, Brown University
PhD in computational biology, MIT (in progress)
founders.background_notes: Five years as a paramedic; gave up a medical school place; published in Science, Nature Biotechnology and Nature Neuroscience (YC page). He and Yaari met on the first day of their MIT PhD programs (YC launch post).

competitors.name: ResistanceBio
competitors.what: AI driven platform focused on cancer drug resistance
competitors.funding_then: 12M seed reported July 2022, one profile site only

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires novel AI models of cancer biology plus wet lab validation and eventually clinical development; research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Platform and IP could be strong if validated, but drug candidates and data were unproven at founding and many AI drug discovery firms attacked similar problems.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; large pharmas partner rather than copy.

market_need_then: YC launch post states over 80 percent of cancer patients are ineligible for targeted therapies and that drug development costs over 2.5 billion dollars per drug, which makes small patient populations uneconomic.

branding.domain_note: Uses serinus.bio; site was a coming soon placeholder when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific, mission focused; launch post titled killing cancer with its own genetics

brand_strength.rationale: Placeholder website and no press on the brand; science and investors matter more in biotech.

outcome_analysis: Serinus is a very early AI drug discovery company from two MIT PhDs, admitted to YC in Summer 2022. Public information is thin: the website was a placeholder, no verified funding round was found, and the team was listed at 6 people. There is no evidence of failure or of a breakthrough, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Funding figures appear only on aggregators and are unverified: 500K YC pre-seed (2022-09), 1.1M seed (one aggregator), about 150K in 2023-11 with Merck Digital Sciences Studio. The competitor ResistanceBio comes from a single profile site whose URL slug names a different company, so treat as low confidence. Name origin unknown; Serinus is a bird genus but no source links it to the company. Completeness pass: three rounds rest on single databases or outlets each (Bouncewatch 500K pre-seed 2022-09-07, VCBacked 150K 2023-11, Signalbase 1.1M seed undated). Employbl totals 650K, which matches the first two but not the 1.1M seed; the 1.1M figure is unconfirmed and conflicts with that total, so do not sum.
